links.outcome: Accuracy of biomarker-driven treatment recommendations, RAG-LLM using MOAlmanac versus LLM-only
links.effect: RAG-LLM reached up to 95% accuracy on synthetic queries and 93% on real-world oncologist queries; it was benchmarked against an LLM-only approach, but no LLM-only figures are given in the text.
links.quote: Our RAG-LLM achieved up to 95% accuracy on synthetic queries and 93% on real-world queries collected from practicing oncologists.

unlisted_practices: Comparing prompting and retrieval strategies to improve precision oncology recommendation accuracy

screen.practice: retrieval grounding with curated knowledge base (MOAlmanac RAG)
screen.reason: The study empirically tests whether adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG using MOAlmanac) to an existing LLM improves biomarker-driven precision oncology recommendations compared to an LLM-only approach.
